args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After v2.3.1 was deployed to production, checkout-api started failing health checks (healthy=false, error rate 18%) in us-east, us-west and eu-west. I rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was healthy in staging only, so it was not used. Next steps: confirm health has recovered and find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before trying to deploy it again.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's passing health checks again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Before:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. The service was failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- **Which version:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. I skipped v2.3.1-rc because it was only ever healthy in staging, not production.
- **After:** v2.3.0 is running in all three regions, the service is healthy, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** It describes the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback. It also lists next steps: keep watching that the service stays healthy, and find what broke in v2.3.1 before deploying it again.

content.text: The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0. v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging, so it doesn't qualify.
